title: The unexpected candidate
items: 10:00 · Mia interviews Leo in meeting room B.
10:05 · Loud eating noises under the table. The manager thinks Leo is eating.
10:06 · Ben finds his lunch box empty under the interview table.
10:07 · The manager stops the interview and asks Leo about the noise.
10:05 · A dog eats Ben’s sandwich under the table. Mia talks to Leo.
09:30 · Ben leaves his sandwich in an open lunch box beside the table.
08:30 · Mia to Ben: The dog sitter cancelled. I brought Max in my bag. Please keep it secret.
10:10 · Mia explains everything. Leo gets another interview. Max waits outside with Ben.
steps: simple
What did the manager think?
Report a completed reaction.
The manager thought Leo was eating under the table.
simple
Why did the manager stop the interview?
Use because to explain the event.
The manager stopped the interview because he heard a strange noise.
continuous
What was Mia doing while Max was eating?
Two actions at the same time.
Mia was interviewing Leo while Max was eating Ben’s sandwich.
continuous
Ask about Max’s activity at 10:05.
Ask what was in progress.
What was Max doing at five past ten?
perfect
Why was Max in the office? Explain the earlier events.
Look back from the interview.
Mia had brought Max to the office because the dog sitter had cancelled.
perfect
Why could Max reach the sandwich?
What Ben did before the interview.
Ben had left his lunch box open beside the table.

Leo got another interview, and Max waited outside with Ben.

title: We will miss you… apparently
items: Friday · 16:00 · A cake for Ben: WE WILL MISS YOU.
16:00 · Ben enters the meeting room with his manager. Everyone shouts Surprise!
16:02 · Why does everyone think I’m quitting? I still work here.
15:55 · The team hides the cake. Ben talks to his manager in the corridor.
Thursday · Mia shares the cropped screenshot. The team orders a farewell cake.
Thursday · Ben: I’m leaving this group chat. Too many messages! I’m not leaving my job.
16:10 · Ben cuts the cake. Everyone laughs and keeps working together.
steps: simple
What happened when Ben entered the room?
Describe the main event.
Everyone shouted Surprise when Ben entered the room.
simple
Did Ben quit his job? Give a full negative answer.
A finished event: negative.
No, Ben did not quit his job.
continuous
What was the team doing while Ben was in the corridor?
Describe the background activity.
The team was hiding the cake while Ben was talking to his manager.
continuous
Ask who Ben was talking to at 15:55.
Who + auxiliary + subject.
Who was Ben talking to at five to four?
perfect
Explain why the team planned a farewell party.
What they read before the party.
The team had read only part of Ben’s message.
perfect
What had the team ordered before Ben arrived?
An earlier completed action.
The team had ordered a farewell cake before Ben arrived.

models.b1: The team held a surprise party for Ben on Friday. When he entered with his manager, everyone shouted Surprise. They were hiding the cake while Ben was talking to his manager in the corridor. They had ordered a farewell cake because they had seen a cropped message. Ben had written that he was leaving the group chat, not his job. He did not quit. At ten past four, he cut the cake and everyone laughed.
models.b2: The team held a surprise party for Ben on Friday. When he entered with his manager, everyone shouted Surprise. In fact, the employee just wanted a break from a constant stream of messages and the collective overwhelm.

title: The ring at table twelve
items: Paris · Café Lumière · Mia and Ben · table 12 · 20:00
20:30 · A waiter puts a dessert with a ring in front of Mia.
20:31 · I said yes. Ben looked completely confused.
20:31 · A guest at table 21 stands up and waves urgently at the waiter.
20:30 · Ben reads the menu while the waiter puts down the dessert.
20:20 · Dessert with ring requested for table 21. Waiter reads the number as 12.
20:35 · Ben to his friend: I didn’t order a ring. I had only booked a normal dinner.
20:40 · Apology accepted. Ring delivered to table 21. Mia and Ben get a free dessert.
steps: simple
How did Mia respond to the ring?
Describe her reaction.
Mia said yes.
simple
What did the guest at table 21 do?
Two completed actions.
The guest stood up and waved at the waiter.
continuous
What was Ben doing when the dessert arrived?
The activity interrupted by the arrival.
Ben was reading the menu when the dessert arrived.
continuous
Ask who the guest was waving at.
Ask about an action in progress.
Who was the guest waving at?
perfect
Explain how the dessert reached the wrong table.
The mistake before the delivery.
The waiter had read table 21 as table 12.
perfect
Had Ben planned a proposal? Give a full negative answer.
The plan before dinner.
No, Ben had not planned a proposal. He had only booked a normal dinner.

The waiter took the ring to the right table. Mia and Ben got a free dessert.

title: The gift that came back
items: 25 December · From Mia to Aunt Rose
14:00 · Rose opens Mia’s gift: a blue teapot in an old box.
Inside: To Mia, love Aunt Rose. 25 December, last year.
14:02 · Uncle Leo recognises the teapot and laughs. Mia looks embarrassed.
24 December · Mia wraps the unopened box while Ben writes Christmas cards.
Last Christmas · Rose gave me this box. I put it in the cupboard without opening it.
Two Christmases ago · To Rose, love Leo. The same blue teapot appears in a family photo.
14:15 · Mia, Rose and Leo drink tea from the teapot together.
steps: simple
What did Rose find in the box?
A completed discovery.
Rose found a blue teapot in the box.
simple
How did Leo react?
Two finished actions.
Leo recognised the teapot and laughed.
continuous
What was Ben doing while Mia was wrapping the box?
Two activities happening together.
Ben was writing Christmas cards while Mia was wrapping the box.
continuous
Ask what Mia was wrapping.
Ask about the activity.
What was Mia wrapping?
perfect
Why did Mia not recognise the teapot?
Something had not happened before this Christmas.
Mia had not opened the box before this Christmas.
perfect
Who had given Rose the teapot first?
Follow the earlier gift card.
Leo had given Rose the teapot two Christmases earlier.

Mia felt embarrassed. Later, all three drank tea from the teapot.

title: Secret Santa knows too much
items: Mug text: Another meeting? I quit.
16:02 · That was a joke I wrote privately to my manager. Who read our messages?
16:03 · The manager reads the mug and laughs. Ben asks who made it.
15:55 · Ben finishes a task while Mia puts the wrapped mug on his desk.
Thursday · Mia orders a mug using a screenshot from the office group chat.
Three weeks earlier · Ben accidentally shares a screenshot of his private joke. He deletes it two minutes later. Mia has already saved it.
16:10 · You posted it yourself! I thought you wanted everyone to see the joke. Ben explains the mistake.
steps: simple
What did Ben receive at the party?
A completed event.
Ben received a mug at the party.
simple
How did the manager react?
A finished reaction.
The manager read the mug and laughed.
continuous
What was Ben doing when Mia left the gift?
An activity in progress.
Ben was finishing a task when Mia left the gift on his desk.
continuous
Ask what Mia was putting on Ben’s desk.
Ask about the activity.
What was Mia putting on Ben’s desk?
perfect
How did Mia get the private joke?
An earlier accidental action.
Ben had accidentally shared a screenshot in the office group chat.
perfect
Why did deleting the screenshot not help?
What Mia did before Ben deleted it.
Mia had saved the screenshot before Ben deleted it.
